quests.title: The Thorn Barrier
quests.summary: Thorns choke the Whispering Wood and the goblins feed them. Find Ranger Willa and reach the Old Oak Grove.

steps.text: Find Ranger Willa in the Whispering Wood (the path in the north-west). Follow the water and find who feeds the thorn barrier.
Cut through the withered brambles and reach the Old Oak Grove.
Speak with Ranger Willa in the grove.
Bring the Warden's Seal to Mayor Orrin.

quests.title: Escort Through the Hollow Cave
quests.where: Hollow Cave, north of the village
quests.summary: Elder Mahina asked you to see a chapel healer, Miya, through the Hollow Cave and out to the Colosseum.

steps.text: Meet Miya at the arch of the Hollow Cave, north of the village.
Escort Miya through the Hollow Cave. Light the lamps, raise the causeway and open the Sovereign's door.
Help the Colosseum guards: the Drowned Sovereign is tearing them apart.

quests.title: Slave of the Colosseum
quests.summary: You are in the Colosseum's pit. Win fights for the Overseer and climb the ladder. The crowd wants to buy your collar.

steps.text: Fight for the Overseer until you rise past the freedom rank.
The releasing ceremony is at dawn. Rest on your cot in your cell to pass the night.
Someone is coming for you in the dark.

quests.title: Find Miya
quests.summary: Captain Varro said Miya was taken to the Colosseum infirmary. Rook says she never was.

steps.text: Win your way out of the Pit, then find Miya.
Find Miya. She is waiting for you at the edge of the landing pad.

quests.title: Outpost Kestrel
quests.summary: You came through the rift. Captain Rhea and a rift scholar named Lyra want to talk to you.

steps.text: Reunite with Miya, then hear Rook out. He is near the landing pad.
Rook says the answers are in the Vault. Speak with Captain Rhea first.
Find Lyra, the rift scholar Captain Rhea told you about (the mess hall, west of the pad).

quests.title: The Shard Vault
quests.summary: Lyra's compass points beneath the base. Clear the Shard Vault and defeat the Vault Warden.

steps.text: Take the hatch west of the landing pad and clear the Shard Vault. Fight through the floating maze (west walkway first) and defeat the Vault Sentinel.
The east gate is open. Reach the Phase Stalker at the end of the east maze.
Cross the north walkways and defeat the Rift Colossus. The Warden's core lies beyond.
The north sector is cleared. The sealed door to the Warden's core is open.

quests.title: The Shattered Reach
quests.summary: A new coordinate has resolved on the rift console.

steps.text: A new coordinate has resolved on the rift console. Step into the rift gate east of the landing pad.
Fight across the floating ruins and defeat the Breach Warden to open the gate to the second court.
Cross the bridge and defeat the Rift Harbinger in its arena.
The Harbinger has fallen. Step through the rift gate back to Outpost Kestrel.

quests.title: The Door in the Vault
quests.summary: Rook says the sealed door at the heart of the Vault has never opened for anyone. He wants to see what it does for you.

steps.text: The Warden has fallen. Rook is waiting at the end of the arena.
The door has opened.

quests.title: Rebuild Dawnwatch
quests.summary: The Mind has the shard and Kenji's party has fallen into a world with nowhere to go. A mason named Brannoch wants to raise the ruined keep of Dawnwatch again. Find its people, win its fights and pay for its stone.

steps.text: Speak with the mason, Brannoch, by the camp.
Phase II, the Camp: find Orla (west rubble) and Tilda (old chapel cellar, east), then pay Brannoch (600 gold, 12 shards).
Phase III, the Village: find Pell (the wagon outside the south gate) and Wick (the east pond), defeat the Hollow Knight at the keep door, then pay Brannoch (1800 gold, 35 shards).
Phase IV, the Castle Town: find Sennet (north-east library ruin) and Dove (north-east tower), defeat the Cult Seer outside the north postern, then pay Brannoch (4200 gold, 70 shards).

quests.title: Under the Ruins
quests.summary: Brannoch cannot lift or dig under a humming paved ring in the north-west ruin. Kenji's mark answers it. Dawnwatch's real name is Eldergate, and a buried network of gates lies beneath it.

steps.text: Lay your hand on the humming ring stone in Dawnwatch's north-west ruin.
Beneath the ruins, read the Chronicle plates (hall and east alcove) and the Watcher's Ledger (west alcove), then touch the Core.
Step through the open Veyra gate (third from the east along the north wall).

quests.title: Veyra, the Kingdom of Ash
quests.summary: Veyra is a kingdom burning its own hearth to keep warm. In the outer village of Cinder Hollow, a courier named Reya guards the last of the medicine. The royal garrison took the rest.

steps.text: Recover Cinder Hollow's confiscated medicine from the royal garrison on the north road.
Take the medicine to Marta in the sick house, west of the well.

quests.title: Pua's Lost Net
quests.summary: A storm swept Pua's best net up the stream into the Whispering Wood.

steps.text: Pua (island pier): find his lost fishing net in the Whispering Wood.
Pua: bring the net back.

quests.title: The Goblin Brute
quests.summary: A goblin brute smashes Old Tane's fence every night.

steps.text: Old Tane (island farm): beat the goblin brute by his fence.
Old Tane: collect your reward.

quests.title: Torn Glyph Pages
quests.summary: Three torn pages of Nema's moon-glyph survey are scattered: one near the cave path, two in the Whispering Wood.

steps.text: Scholar Nema (island): find the torn glyph pages (cave path, Whispering Wood).

quests.title: The Spirit Spring
quests.summary: Mossbeard asks you to drink from the spirit spring and listen.

steps.text: Mossbeard (Whispering Wood): drink from the spirit spring.
Mossbeard: tell him what you heard.

quests.title: The Silver Locket
quests.summary: Mara lost a silver locket with a blue stone on the harbour road.

steps.text: Mara (Colosseum town): find her locket on the harbour road.
Mara: return the locket.

quests.title: The Runaway Knight
quests.summary: Pip wants the runaway knight on the road dealt with.

steps.text: Pip (Colosseum town): defeat the runaway knight on the road.
Pip: collect your reward.

quests.title: Loose Salvage
quests.summary: Three salvage crates have gone astray around the outpost.

steps.text: Scrapper Vel (Outpost Kestrel): recover the loose salvage crates.

quests.title: The Rogue Drone
quests.summary: A drone has gone rogue past the east scaffolding.

steps.text: Corporal Dun (Outpost Kestrel): shut down the rogue drone past the east scaffolding.
Corporal Dun: collect the reserve.
